title: .config/ianf-tracker.toml, version 1
description: Where a repository's issues go, for jira-tools, product-map and dora-tools. jira-tools and product-map read it as it is in the worktree you're in; dora-tools reads the copy committed on the code host's default branch. See ianf-tracker.example.toml in jira-tools.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

kind.description: The tracker. jira-tools handles only jira.

site.description: The Jira Cloud site, such as your-site.atlassian.net.

space.description: The key of the space issues are filed in: the prefix of its issue keys, as in PROJ-123.

issue_type.description: The type issues are filed as. `jira create --type` overrides it.

labels.description: Labels every issue gets. `jira create --label` adds more.

stages.description: The status in your workflow each stage is kept in. A stage left out is kept as a stage-<name> label.

status.description: A status in your Jira workflow, by its name.
